data.title: 莲华 · 屏风红榻前的青烟万华
data.description: 幽暗古朴的和室榻榻米深处，金泥彩绘屏风散发着微光。莲华慵懒侧卧在深绯丝绒软垫上，修长指尖执着烟斗吐出缭绕青烟，万华镜在她膝前流转着奇诡光斑。
data.location: dim traditional Japanese room with antique painted folding screens and velvet zabuton floor cushions
data.action: reclining gracefully on side, holding an ornate long kiseru smoking pipe with curling smoke, mysterious alluring gaze toward viewer
data.lighting: 屏风微光与烛台纸灯笼暖影
data.promptProse: Renge reclines languidly against a gilded Japanese folding screen holding a slender smoking pipe, watching the viewer through curling blue smoke.
data.animaCaption: Faint lantern glow illuminates the curling pipe smoke against the gold folding screen. The lantern illuminates her face, pipe and the painted folding screen.
